brief: Continuous mobile camera capture with instant cloud/LAN sync, automated faster-whisper transcription, Gemini AI highlight extraction, 9:16 vertical re-framing with karaoke captions, and autonomous multi-platform publishing.

concepts.name: Velocity D
concepts.idea: Muscular architectural capital D with an embedded forward play / dispatch chevron in negative space.
rationale: Immediate letterform recognition combined with universal video play signifier
Engineered with 30-degree isometric angles and 100/100 production-readiness geometry
Robust 44px walls that scale effortlessly from 16px favicons to high-definition launcher icons

recommendation: Velocity D is the definitive brand mark for Dispatch: bold, unmistakably engineered, and built to anchor both mobile capture and PC media pipeline experiences.
